models.name: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B

engines.hardware: One NVIDIA DGX Spark; independent rebuild of the vendor's ~64K-token Moby-Dick passage-copy test, 66K-token prompt, default DFlash drafter with 75% draft acceptance
engines.quant: unsloth UD-Q4_K_XL with a quantized KV cache; the same model writes a new story at 50.4 t/s (0.79x Ollama) with 43% acceptance

engines.hardware: One NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10), same box and prompt shape as the copy test
engines.quant: registry tag Q4_K_M with built-in MTP drafter; writes a new story after a 67K-token prompt (Magnitude 50.4 t/s on the same round)

models.why: The model local-AI benches argue about: on one DGX Spark, Magnitude copies a passage 2.17x faster than Ollama (188.9 vs 87.2 t/s) but writes a new story at 0.79x Ollama's speed (50.4 vs 63.4 t/s), so "over 2x" holds only for the vendor's copy test.
